$comment: Transcription of the official MCP reference memory server (@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory) in tools/list shape. Tool names, input properties and required fields follow the published server; the shared Entity/Relation $defs mirror the knowledge-graph structures the server stores, and outputSchema gives the structured form of the returned JSON. Scopes added by Waypoint (memory:read / memory:write).

tools.description: Create multiple new entities in the knowledge graph. Entities that already exist are skipped.
tools.name: create_entities

tools.description: Create multiple new relations between entities in the knowledge graph. Relations are stored in active voice (for example, 'Alice works_at Acme'). Relations that already exist are skipped.
tools.name: create_relations

tools.description: Add new observations to existing entities in the knowledge graph. Fails if an observation names an entity that does not exist.
tools.name: add_observations

tools.description: Delete multiple entities and all their associated relations from the knowledge graph. Succeeds silently for entities that do not exist.
tools.name: delete_entities

tools.description: Delete specific observations from entities in the knowledge graph. Succeeds silently for observations that do not exist.
tools.name: delete_observations

tools.description: Delete multiple relations from the knowledge graph. Succeeds silently for relations that do not exist.
tools.name: delete_relations

tools.description: Read the entire knowledge graph: all entities and all relations between them.
tools.name: read_graph

tools.description: Search for nodes in the knowledge graph by a query. The search matches entity names, entity types and observation content, and returns the matching entities together with the relations between them.
tools.name: search_nodes

tools.description: Open specific nodes in the knowledge graph by their names. Returns the requested entities together with the relations between them.
tools.name: open_nodes
